items.name: Bally's Chicago permanent casino
items.claim: Bally's Chicago marked a topping-off at its permanent casino site on May 1, 2026, placing the final structural beam for a $1.7 billion riverfront development slated to open in spring 2027, expected to create approximately 3,000 permanent jobs.
items.source_excerpt: Bally's Chicago (BALY) marked a topping-off at its permanent casino site on May 1, 2026, placing the final structural beam for a $1.7 billion riverfront development slated to open in spring 2027 . The project is expected to create approximately 3,000 permanent jobs , has employed more than 1,000 tradespeople to date, and will include a 500-room hotel, 3,400 slot machines, 173 table games, a 3,000-seat theater, 10 food-and-beverage venues, and riverfront public spaces.

notes: Bally's Chicago permanent casino is the issuer's disclosed capital project (not itself a prediction-market product); no separate backlog/RPO figure or prediction-market-specific named contract found in stored evidence for BALY.
